name: HaluBench
description: HaluBench is a comprehensive hallucination evaluation benchmark consisting of 15,000 samples from various real-world domains. It is designed to evaluate hallucination detection capabilities of large language models, particularly in retrieval augmented generation scenarios.
reputation: Widely cited as a dedicated hallucination benchmark for RAG and general LLM factuality evaluation, though it is newer than long-established NLP benchmarks.
notes: Benchmark designed for hallucination detection; released alongside LYNX hallucination detection model.
